name: Glyph of Warding (Kingmaker)
disable: DC 34 Thievery check (trained) to remove the glyph without triggering it, or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 34) to counteract the glyph.

items.name: Release Spell
items.text:
Trigger A creature attempting to open the desk drawer or the secret door to area D6 triggers the associated glyph

Effect The glyph of warding targets the creature with a Spirit Blast (DC 34 basic Fortitude save save).

text: An hourglass-shaped glyph flashes with mauve light, then seems to quickly drain its sand away, as if to indicate time has suddenly run out.
